title: All Video Downloader & Home
summary: All Video Downloader For Social Media & Video Saver.
description:
All Video Downloader & Home combines an optional Home Launcher with a simple video downloading experience. Personalize your home screen, quickly access your favorite apps, search installed apps, and save supported videos in just a few taps.

Features

• Simple and easy Home Launcher
• Swipe up to view all installed apps
• Fast app search
• Quick access to your favorite apps
• Customize your home screen
• Light, Dark, and System themes
• Download supported videos in multiple formats
• Simple, fast, and easy-to-use experience

Important Information

This app includes an optional Home Launcher. If you choose to set it as your default Home app, your device's home screen appearance, wallpaper, and layout may change. Your installed apps, files, photos, videos, and personal data remain on your device and are not removed.
